import pandas as pd
import csv

input_path = 'outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Pivot the data: city_id, city_name, year as index, indicator_id as columns
# The value column becomes the cell values
pivot_df = df.pivot_table(

    columns='indicator_id',
    values='value',
    aggfunc='first'  # In case of duplicates, take the first value

import pandas as pd
import csv
import os

# Read input data
input_path = 'outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Pivot the data: city_id, city_name, year as index, indicator_id as columns
# The value column becomes the cell values

    index=['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'],
    columns='indicator_id',
    values='value',
    aggfunc='first'  # In case of duplicates, take the first value
)

# Reset index to make city_id, city_name, year regular columns
pivot_df = pivot_df.reset_index()

# Sort by city_id and year for consistent output
pivot_df = pivot_df.sort_values(by=['city_id', 'year']).reset_index(drop=True)

# Write to CSV with RFC 4180 compliance
